postal_system.assignment_rule: The pinned Umhvørvisstovan Postnr layer establishes the mapped three-digit postøki identity and geometry for this release. It does not establish recipient-specific deliverability or postal-operator service eligibility.
postal_system.geometry_rule: Publish source Polygon or MultiPolygon geometry after WGS84 transformation and validation. Postal code 476 alone receives the documented deterministic topology repair and is labelled derived; no buffer is used to invent an absent postal area.
postal_system.non_area_rule: A PO box, organization, route, service point or delivery exception without source area geometry remains non-area. Municipality, place, point, building, Voronoi and AGID geometry are never substituted.
postal_system.address_rule: Address points and address components belong to the separate Umhvørvisstovan address register and are not included in this M2 release.
postal_system.building_rule: No address-to-building relation or building geometry is inferred from the postal area. Buildings require a separately licensed explicit source relation.
postal_system.licence_rule: Every source page, service definition and query snapshot pins URL, retrieval time, service version, SHA-256, attribution and the June 2019 free-map-data terms.
postal_system.territory_rule: FO retains its own country/territory identity. This release neither merges FO into DK nor changes the source layer's coverage.

exception_classes.rule: Eight source self-intersections are repaired with Turf buffer 0.000001 metre, steps 8; output is derived with recorded relative area delta.
Return available source geometry and reason, or no area; never synthesize a surface for a PO box, route, organization or point.

stages.definition: Source and authority contracts are reviewable.

Pinned current Umhvørvisstovan Postnr areas, explicit rights and attribution, reproducible immutable artifacts, topology and exception receipts, and real API/app search-to-translucent-area verification all pass.
Separately authorized address and building relations pass identifier, privacy, accuracy and redistribution gates.
